import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Group by top-level directory, excluding skills (system files)
grouped = {}
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.split("/")
    top = parts[0]
    grouped.setdefault(top, []).append(e)

# Print organized listing
for folder in sorted(grouped.keys()):
    items = grouped[folder]
    total_size = sum(i["size_bytes"] for i in items)
    print(f"\n📁 {folder}/ ({len(items)} files, {total_size:,} bytes)")
    for item in items:
        rel = item["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
        size_kb = item["size_bytes"] / 1024
        print(f"   {'📄' if not item['is_dir'] else '📁'} {rel}  ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"Total: {len(entries)} files across {len(grouped)} top-level directories")
